name: Sawamura Anna
source:
She is pure and graceful. She is overprotective of her son Mitsuo, but he is not related to him by blood, as she married his father when he was still young (her husband passed away in a car accident when Mitsuo was still young).

She has never given birth, so even at her age, she is young and very pretty. She is puzzled by Mitsuo's gradual growth into an adult.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=397805]getchu[/url]]
